description: This Java class 'UtilNumber' provides utility methods for number formatting, including locale-specific rule-based formatting, BigDecimal scale and rounding configuration, and percentage formatting. It also manages ICU4J rule sets for different locales and offers methods for safe BigDecimal operations.

classes.name: UtilNumber
classes.description: A utility class for number formatting, locale-specific rule-based formatting, and BigDecimal configuration.

methods.name: getBigDecimalScale
methods.description: Retrieves BigDecimal scale from properties file, defaults to 2.

methods.name: getBigDecimalRoundingMode
methods.description: Deprecated method to get BigDecimal rounding mode as int from properties.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Retrieves RoundingMode based on property value, defaults to RoundingMode.HALF_UP.

methods.name: formatRuleBasedAmount
methods.description: Formats amount into words based on locale-specific ICU4J rule sets.

methods.name: toPercentString
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string with specified scale and rounding mode.

methods.name: safeAdd
methods.description: Adds two BigDecimal numbers safely, ignoring nulls.

methods.name: getBigDecimal
methods.description: Resolves BigDecimal from a context map with default fallback.
